timeline: Why did eight thousand armed rebel soldiers fail to crush the trapped garrison inside the Lucknow Residency in 1857?
Nearly seventeen hundred British and Indian soldiers and civilians were trapped inside the fortified compound.
Outside, eight thousand rebel sepoys surrounded the grounds with heavy artillery.
Days turned into weeks of relentless bombardment and underground mine explosions.
Rations dwindled while disease swept through the crowded rooms of the compound.
Help was delayed as relief forces struggled through flooded monsoon roads.
Yet despite relentless attacks, the garrison fought back with sorties and counter-mining to survive.
They held out for 87 days before the initial relief forces finally broke through.
How did a tiny garrison survive the 1857 siege of the Lucknow Residency when British authority across Oudh had completely evaporated?
